name: i.safe MOBILE IS910.2
statusNote: i.safe MOBILE has moved it to the archive of its range.
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS910.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 8-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. i.safe MOBILE also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It runs Android 8. It has been discontinued; the i.safe MOBILE IS930.2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0, checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery charged outside Ex areas only; protect from high-energy impacts, UV and static charge; ambient −20 °C to +60 °C.

specs.display: 8-inch Corning Gorilla Glass V3, usable with gloves
specs.chip: Qualcomm Snapdragon MSM8953 (quad core on IS910.1 page; octa core on IS910.2 page)
specs.ports: USB-C; magnetic charger port; microSD; micro-SIM; charging contacts for dock and multi charger
